Jones over loses if Mason, priced at 46.5 rush with almost no receiving, takes the early downs and MIN spends the second half throwing, leaving Jones on the 34-yard outcome, especially if those 2025 rush totals were a lead-back role he no longer has. Those are real loss paths. They are not stronger than the reads: the under is the side in three of Jacobs' last four at this exact number, and Jones' number is 44.5, not a workhorse total, with Brinson already out. Still a lean, not a strong, because the OL tags are questionable and the fallback year may not be this roster.
